_additiveNote: What core 6.0.0 adds over core 5.0.5, by name.

breaking.text: Machines: a discrete machine (CNC, injection moulding) is a WorkCell of a ProductionLine — ISA-95 Part 1 role-based hierarchy, discrete production (audit H1) — no longer a Unit of a ProcessCell (the batch branch). SMProfile-Machine, -CNC-Machine, -InjectionMoldingMachine fix no place (owner 29.10.2026: the level is where the instance stands; the class keeps only the generic WorkUnit the level lint needs, audit M-03) — in a ProductionLine a machine is a WorkCell, free-standing a WorkUnit of a WorkCenter; Machine PART_OF WorkCenter (see machine-part-of-work-center); a plant's lines become ProductionLine, their machines WorkCell. The codes stay, so the UNS addresses of the line machines stay (the free-standing ones move once, see pool-is-equipment-class); every reader of a level (rules, screens) takes a work unit as a machine.

Work centers: every work center of the plant tree (ProductionLine, WorkCenter, ProcessCell …) is an instance of SMProfile-WorkCenter — the generic work center of ISA-95 Part 1/2, one KG label WorkCenter keyed by element_id; its role is the instance's equipmentLevel (B2MML Equipment.EquipmentLevel). Machine PART_OF ProductionLine, a tree target without a node label in the contract (audit M-04), is gone: a machine is PART_OF its WorkCenter, whatever role the work center plays. The ids and codes stay, so the UNS addresses stay; a reader that matched (:ProductionLine) matches (:WorkCenter) and reads the level from the instance.

ERP pools leave the equipment tree (owner 29.10.2026 ~22:45, supersedes X2 of the same day): an ERP pool (POOL-SGM, POOL-CNC) is an EquipmentClass — a capability / planning group, source erp-machine-pools — and no work center. The 35 free-standing machines of werk1 (18 injection moulding, 17 CNC) are WorkUnits of one workshop WorkCenter per area: sgm-workshop "Spritzguss-Werkstatt" and cnc-workshop "CNC-Werkstatt" replace the work centers sgm-pool (code pool-sgm) and cnc-pool (code pool-cnc). Machine ids and codes stay; their UNS address moves once, in this core: factory/werk1/sgm/pool-sgm/<machine> → factory/werk1/sgm/sgm-workshop/<machine>, factory/werk1/cnc/pool-cnc/<machine> → factory/werk1/cnc/cnc-workshop/<machine>. Machines in real lines keep their place and address.

Production order: status speaks the B2MML RequestState vocabulary (B2MML-Common.xsd RequestState1Type) instead of our own list — offen → Waiting, freigegeben → Released, in_arbeit → Running, fertig → Completed, abgeschlossen → Closed, storniert → Cancelled (the way the customer order moved in core 5.0.0); the rule material_ready_after_planned_end guards Released and Running; a source maps its words with valueMap.

Operations response, segment response, job response, job order, work response, work order: status speaks the B2MML state lists (ResponseState1Type, JobOrderDispatchStatus1Type, RequestState1Type) — the operations response's in_arbeit / fertig become Running / Completed; a source maps its words with valueMap (ERP: IN_PROCESS and PARTIAL_CONFIRMED → Running, FINAL_CONFIRMED → Completed; PLANNED → Waiting, RELEASED → Released, IN_PROGRESS → Running, COMPLETED → Completed, CANCELLED → Cancelled, ON_HOLD → Held).

Process segment and operations segment: operations_type speaks B2MML OperationsType (Production, Maintenance, Quality, Inventory, Mixed, Other) instead of lower-case words; a source maps production → Production, quality → Quality, inventory → Inventory, maintenance → Maintenance.

Segment requirement and segment response: material_use speaks B2MML MaterialUse (Consumable, Consumed, Produced, By-product Produced, Co-product Produced, Yield Produced, Material Consumed, Material Produced, Destructive Sample, Returned Sample, Retained Sample, Inventoried, Other) instead of our own list (ByProduct, Sample, MovedFrom, MovedTo); no source of the demo plant fills it today.

Every attribute mapped onto a B2MML field with a code list carries that list as its enum (lint-isa95 I19): work_type / operations_type, the schedule, performance and directive states, capability_type, the operations event type, level, MOM and enterprise function, assembly type and relationship, relationship type and form, dependency, definition type, spatial format. A source that sends another word maps it with valueMap.

Tool becomes Tooling (owner D3 13.10.2026, audit H2): an abstract physical asset with the kinds Mould, Die, CuttingTool and Fixture; parts_per_shot (the cavity count) lives on the Mould, tool_type is the profile itself, unit_ref and the edges Tool IMPLEMENTATION_OF Machine / InjectionMoldingMachine IMPLEMENTED_BY Tool are gone — the tool a machine runs with is the segment's PhysicalAssetRequirement / PhysicalAssetActual (REQUIRES_PHYSICAL_ASSET / ACTUAL_PHYSICAL_ASSET → Tooling). Every edge to Tool now targets Tooling; the key stays tool_id.

Segment requirement and segment response: process_segment_ref is no longer filled with the ERP work center of the operation (POOL-SGM, POOL-CNC — equipment, not a process segment; audit M-11), and the FOR_PROCESS_SEGMENT edge on it is gone from erp-segment-requirements (it never resolved: the process segments are VORMONTAGE, MONTAGE, PRUEFFELD, VERSAND). process_segment_ref stays declared and is unbound until the ERP serves the routing operation's process segment. The work center is the operation's equipment requirement by class instead (owner 29.10.2026: the pool is an EquipmentClass): erp-segment-requirements maps work_center onto equipment_class_ref (B2MML SegmentRequirement.EquipmentRequirement.EquipmentClassID) and draws REQUIRES_EQUIPMENT → EquipmentClass.

additive.text: Orders, requests and responses carry their ISA-95 operations type on the wire (audit M1): operations_type on production order, segment requirement, operations response, segment response, BDE confirmation, operations definition and product definition; work_type on work order, job order, work response and job response — B2MML OperationsType / WorkType, the code list as enum; a source without the column sets the profile's constant (Production). Additive: a new attribute.

Where ISA-95 has the field, the attribute names it (audit M2, M3, M4, L1, L3, L5): the operations definition's article is its produced material specification, planned start, department, good quantity, labour and machine minutes, the NC program, the product parameters and their bands, the machine setpoints map onto B2MML (conditional paths such as MaterialActual[MaterialUse=Produced]); the inspection lot's created_at is no evaluation date; qty_planned is quantity's name; the Level-4 extensions name no MOM domain. Documentation and mapping only: no value changes.

ISA-95 Part 4 work alerts (PLAN-0700 S4): SMProfile-WorkAlert and SMProfile-WorkAlertDefinition after B2MML 0701 WorkAlert / WorkAlertDefinition — message, time stamp, priority, category, the effective dates. With them every ISA-95 information object of B2MML 0701 has a profile (the BatchML objects are the ISA-88 profiles'). Additive: two new profiles.

ISA-95 Part 2 cl. 5.9 test results of the resources (PLAN-0700 S2): SMProfile-TestResult after B2MML 0701 TestResult — a personnel qualification test, an equipment or a physical asset capability test names the person, machine or tool it tested (TESTS); B2MML 0701 has one TestResult for every testable object (the 2013 QualificationTestResult, EquipmentCapabilityTestResult, PhysicalAssetCapabilityTestResult). Segment and job responses name it per actual (personnel_ / equipment_ / physical_asset_test_result_ref, HAS_TEST_RESULT); their inspection_lot_ref maps to MaterialActual.TestResult (was PersonnelActual — an inspection lot tests material). Additive: one new profile, three new optional links.

PLM model, part 1 (PLAN-0700 L1–L3, owner 29.10.2026: "wir bauen kein PLM … nur die Modelle"): the article carries its revision (MaterialDefinition.Version — at SAP the suffix dddd.1, dddd.2), a version as the second axis and the stem base_article_ref (both extensions), and its effectivity dates; operations definition and material bill name the BOM in PLM / ERP (BillOfMaterialsID), the operations definition its effectivity dates; SMProfile-TestSpecificationCriterion (B2MML TestSpecificationCriteria) is one characteristic of a test specification, whose version is the drawing revision; the product definition names the characteristic and the revision its band came from (characteristic_ref, source_revision — extensions, never invented). Additive: one new profile, new optional fields.

PLM model, part 2 (PLAN-0700 L4, judged 29.10.2026): the as-built chain names the state it built without a composite key — B2MML references a definition by its ID alone, and at SAP the material number carries the revision (dddd.1). Where a source's id carries no version, operations_definition_version (production order, operations / segment response, segment requirement) and article_revision (material lot, operations / segment / job response, BDE confirmation) name it — optional extensions, never part of a key. Additive.

PLM model, part 3 (PLAN-0700 L5–L7, owner 29.10.2026: effectivity by date and by serial / lot both occur, the ERP is the truth): SMProfile-Effectivity (Date / SerialNumber / Lot / Unit, a range, the end item, the engineering change) — data for traceability, never evaluated; SMProfile-EngineeringChange (ECN, SAP change number) named by article, operations definition and material bill; Article.plm_part_ref (the part in PLM). All extensions with their reason. Additive.

Recipe traceability (PLAN-0700 R5, 29.10.2026): a segment response and a BDE confirmation name the git recipe (recipe_ref) and its released version (recipe_version) the order ran with — optional extensions, filled by the source (the sim with R4). Additive.

Material sublot in its lot (audit M-10, 29.10.2026): MaterialLot MADE_UP_OF Quant is fed from the WMS quant's lot (charge_nr = MaterialSubLot.MaterialLotID, source edge direction in) — before, a quant reached its lot only through ASSEMBLED_FROM (assembly semantics) and no source drew the containment. No key, property or relationship removed. Additive.
